domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's leave application. Central aggregate of the leave management module. Tracks the full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection to cancellation, and carries the audit trail of who acted and when.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT → SUBMITTED: Employee submits the leave request for manager review
DRAFT → CANCELLED: Employee discards a draft without submitting
SUBMITTED → APPROVED: Manager (or HR admin) approves the leave request; balance is decremented
SUBMITTED → REJECTED: Manager (or HR admin) rejects the leave request; balance is unchanged
SUBMITTED → CANCELLED: Employee withdraws a submitted but not-yet-decided request
APPROVED → CANCELLED: Employee cancels previously approved leave or manager revokes it; balance is restored

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Acts as the template from which employee balances are derived. Controls approval requirements, notice periods, accrual behaviour, and accumulation caps.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE: Policy is soft-disabled by HR admin; no new leave requests can use it but existing balances remain
INACTIVE → ACTIVE: Policy is re-enabled by HR admin
ACTIVE → ARCHIVED: Policy is permanently retired (e.g., fiscal year rollover); historical data preserved

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave type and fiscal year. Updated atomically when leave is approved or cancelled. The pendingDays field tracks submitted-but-not-yet-decided leave to prevent over-application.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED: remainingDays reaches 0 after approved leave deductions
ACTIVE → FROZEN: Employee is terminated or on long-term leave; balance is preserved but no new requests allowed
FROZEN → ACTIVE: Employee is reinstated; balance is unfrozen
ACTIVE → ROLLED_OVER: Fiscal year ends; unused days are carried forward per policy rules into a new balance record

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that defines its rules. ANNUAL, SICK, and EMERGENCY are the primary types for this feature; UNPAID, MATERNITY, and PATERNITY are defined for future extension.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee in the organisation. Acts as the actor who submits leave and the subject whose balances are tracked. The managerId establishes the approval chain. Employment status gates leave eligibility.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE → INACTIVE: Employee is temporarily suspended (e.g., long-term leave, secondment); can submit only SICK/EMERGENCY leave
INACTIVE → ACTIVE: Employee is reinstated to full status
ACTIVE → TERMINATED: Employee leaves the organisation; no further leave requests allowed; existing balances are frozen
TERMINATED → ACTIVE: Employee is rehired (rare); new balances are created for the current fiscal year

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveRequest passes through during its lifecycle. Drives all state-transition validation and determines which actions are available at each stage.

domain_entities.name: BalanceStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of states a LeaveBalance can occupy. ACTIVE means the balance is usable. EXHAUSTED means remainingDays is 0. FROZEN means the employee is terminated/inactive and the balance is preserved but unusable. ROLLED_OVER means the balance has been carried into a new fiscal year and is no longer the active record.

business_rules: BR-001 — Date validity: startDate must be strictly before endDate. The computed duration in working days must be >= 0.5 (half-day minimum). Requests with zero or negative duration are rejected at submission.

BR-002 — No retrospective leave: startDate must be >= today's date at the time of submission, unless the leave type is EMERGENCY or SICK, in which case startDate may be up to 3 calendar days in the past.

BR-003 — Minimum notice: For ANNUAL leave, the difference in calendar days between submission date and startDate must be >= the LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays. SICK and EMERGENCY leave are exempt from minimum notice.

BR-015 — Cancellation window: An APPROVED leave may be cancelled by the employee up to the startDate. After the startDate, only a manager or HR_ADMIN may cancel. A SUBMITTED leave may be cancelled by the employee at any time before a decision is rendered.

BR-004 — Balance sufficiency check: At submission, the system computes (remainingDays - pendingDays) for the employee's LeaveBalance matching the request's leaveType and fiscalYear. If the requested duration exceeds this value and the policy's allowsNegativeBalance is false, the submission is rejected with an "insufficient balance" reason. For UNPAID leave, this check is skipped.

BR-005 — Pending days reservation: When a leave request transitions to SUBMITTED, the employee's LeaveBalance.pendingDays is incremented by the request's working-day duration. When the request is APPROVED, pendingDays is decremented and usedDays is incremented by the same amount. When REJECTED or CANCELLED, pendingDays is decremented and usedDays is unchanged.

BR-006 — Balance restoration on cancellation: When an APPROVED leave is cancelled, usedDays is decremented and remainingDays is incremented by the leave's working-day duration. The balance status may transition from EXHAUSTED back to ACTIVE if remainingDays becomes > 0.

BR-007 — Overlapping leave prevention: An employee cannot have two leave requests with overlapping date ranges where both are in SUBMITTED or APPROVED status. Overlap is defined as any calendar-day intersection between [startDate, endDate] of two requests. DRAFT and REJECTED requests are excluded from overlap checks.

BR-009 — Self-approval prohibition: A manager cannot approve or reject their own leave request. If the employee's managerId points to themselves (e.g., CEO), the request must be escalated to an HR_ADMIN for decision.

BR-008 — Manager approval chain: For leave types where LeavePolicy.requiresManagerApproval is true, only the employee's direct manager (Employee.managerId) or a user with HR_ADMIN role may approve or reject. For leave types where requiresManagerApproval is false (e.g., SICK notification-only), the request auto-transitions to APPROVED on submission.

BR-010 — Active employee only: Only employees with employmentStatus === 'ACTIVE' may submit leave requests. TERMINATED employees cannot submit. INACTIVE employees may submit only if the leave type is SICK or EMERGENCY and the leave dates fall within their inactive period.

BR-011 — Max consecutive days: If LeavePolicy.maxConsecutiveDays is set, the working-day duration of a single leave request must not exceed that value. This is enforced at submission. Multiple non-overlapping requests are not aggregated for this check.

BR-012 — Fiscal year alignment: Each LeaveBalance is scoped to a single fiscalYear. When a leave request spans two fiscal years, the system splits the working days across the two years and checks/deducts from the corresponding balances. If either balance is insufficient, the request is rejected.
domain_notes:
## Lifecycle states introduced

### LeaveRequest
- DRAFT → SUBMITTED (employee submits)
- DRAFT → CANCELLED (employee discards)
- SUBMITTED → APPROVED (manager/HR admin approves; balance deducted)
- SUBMITTED → REJECTED (manager/HR admin rejects; balance unchanged)
- SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (employee withdraws before decision)
- APPROVED → CANCELLED (employee cancels before start, or manager revokes; balance restored)

### LeavePolicy
- ACTIVE → INACTIVE (HR admin soft-disables)
- INACTIVE → ACTIVE (HR admin re-enables)
- ACTIVE → ARCHIVED (permanently retired, e.g. fiscal year rollover)

### LeaveBalance
- ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED (remainingDays reaches 0)
- ACTIVE → FROZEN (employee terminated or on long-term leave)
- FROZEN → ACTIVE (employee reinstated)
- ACTIVE → ROLLED_OVER (fiscal year ends; carried forward into new balance)

### Employee
- ACTIVE → INACTIVE (suspended/secondment; limited leave eligibility)
- INACTIVE → ACTIVE (reinstated)
- ACTIVE → TERMINATED (leaves organisation; balances frozen)
- TERMINATED → ACTIVE (rehired; new balances created)

### LeaveRequestStatus enum
DRAFT | SUBMITTED | APPROVED | REJECTED | CANCELLED

### BalanceStatus enum
ACTIVE | EXHAUSTED | FROZEN | ROLLED_OVER

### LeaveType enum
ANNUAL | SICK | EMERGENCY | UNPAID | MATERNITY | PATERNITY

## Key design decisions
- LeaveBalance.pendingDays tracks submitted-but-undecided leave to prevent over-application (BR-005)
- Cross-fiscal-year leave requests are split and checked against both years' balances (BR-012)
- Self-approval is prohibited; escalates to HR_ADMIN (BR-009)
- Auto-approval for leave types with requiresManagerApproval=false (BR-008)
- All state transitions produce audit records (BR-013) and notifications (BR-014)
